fixed_findings: Wallet Git exclusion now probes an existing file's parent directory and normalizes lexical traversal only after rejecting symlink components.
Replay binds absent terminal and consumed-input queries to the exact outpoint, amount and script; every selected consumed input must currently be absent.
Replay ties each accepted row's confirmation policy to the initial sink and requires birth anchor < acceptance score <= frozen frontier.
SDK headers now serialize expanded parents and restore BlueWork losslessly; cached reported hashes are cleared before recomputation.
Fetch runtime uses the actual Node ELF while preserving the system CA mitigation; original pre-JavaScript exit127 attempts are retained.
Benchmark now measures actual JSON decoding from the written fixture separately from generation, encoding/hash and public replay.
reviewed_boundaries: The user pins the founding descriptor; domain, code and VK coherence alone cannot establish the canonical funded instance.
The installed state-free policy template is pinned and compared in full after replacing only approved canonical domain and VK operands.
Network acquisition freezes a finite confirmed frontier; gaps, removals, contradictory spentness and a newly related spend produce incomplete status rather than zero balance.
Network accepted-node trust is explicit; optional local Full execution checks public transactions without a proving key but does not establish consensus or data availability.
The wallet replays fetched public records itself before reading one seed-only backup; a caller-supplied snapshot or descriptor digest is not authority.
Owned amounts cover recognized valid receipts only; failed decryption cannot distinguish foreign from owned but undeliverable ciphertexts.
The revealing fallback requires literal disclosure consent before payload or helper use and binds the quote ID, fee, ALL witness, actual input, owner payout and immutable successor.
The wallet writes signed preparation outside Git with private permissions and has no broadcast interface; fresh node reconciliation remains required before submission.
Synthetic replay requires the explicit UNPROVED mode, returns complete false, has no accepted headers or SDK transaction attestations, and is rejected by the network and wallet entry points.

runtime_conditions.fetch: Two root-requested read-only endpoint runs in separate fresh outputs; 2 CPU, 4 GiB, swap 0, restricted mounts, raw journal, finally stop/reap. Endpoint agreement is not independent consensus.
runtime_conditions.benchmark: One root-authorized 10000-total-operation run only after an actual fresh network positive; 2 CPU, 6 GiB, swap 0, network off. No chain, cryptographic, encrypted-scanning or complete-wallet qualification.
runtime_conditions.owner_wallet: Fresh complete network input and separately selected owner-only runtime/identity are required. Source review does not assert an actual successful owner restore or exit.

limitations: This record is an adversarial implementation review, not a cryptographic audit or production-safety claim.
The old completed terminal trace cannot demonstrate recovery of a currently unspent claim; a fresh service-loss trial is required for that evidence.
Withheld or pruned history and undeliverable ciphertexts remain availability and recovery limitations.
Sustained active-pool catch-up and provider independence are not qualified by a bounded terminal-history refetch.
New private-exit proof/native/helper source is reviewed separately by the private_exit_review lane.
